source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of defining and calling functions (PDF 46).

blocks.text: Function def keyword se banaya jata hai: pehle def, phir function ka naam aur brackets ( ), jin mein parameters (function ko milne wali values ke naam) ho sakte hain. Function ki body (andar ka code) indented honi zaroori hai.

def function_name(parameters):
    # code to be executed

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh function banane ki shakal (syntax) hai, poora program nahi.
"def": function banane ka keyword.
"function_name": yahan apne function ka naam likhein (jaise greet).
"(parameters)": brackets mein woh naam jo function ko values denge; zaroorat na ho to brackets khali reh sakte hain.
":": aakhir mein colon.
"# code to be executed": yahan function ki body (andar ka code) aati hai, indented. Sirf comment rakhne par IndentationError aata hai.
Function banane se woh chalta nahi; usay naam se call karna parta hai, jaise neeche ki misaal mein.
Misaal: kisi insaan ko salaam karne wala function banayein.

def greet(name):
    print("As-Salaam-Alaikum", name)
# Function invoking means call the function by name and perform the required task For example.
greet ('Ali')

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"def greet(name):": greet naam ka function jo ek parameter name leta hai.
"print("As-Salaam-Alaikum", name)": function ki body (indented): salaam ke saath naam print karti hai.
"# Function invoking means ...": comment: function ko naam se bulana (call karna) hi usay chalana hai.
"greet ('Ali')": function call; name ko 'Ali' milta hai aur body chalti hai. Yeh line indented nahi, is liye function se bahar hai.
Output: As-Salaam-Alaikum Ali
Khud try karein: aakhir mein greet('Sara') ki ek aur line jor kar Run karein: doosri line "As-Salaam-Alaikum Sara" aayegi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab greet (‘AH’) wali line function ke andar (indented) chhapti hai; aise yeh call kabhi nahi chalti aur program kuch print nahi karta. Call function ke baad, baen margin se likhi jati hai. Naam bhi 'AH' chhapa hai jabke wazahat 'Ali' kehti hai, aur quotes seedhe (' ') hone chahiyein: greet('Ali').

blocks.prompt: Python mein function banane ke liye kaunsa keyword hai (MCQ 8)?

items: Function ko naam se bulayein: greet('Ali').
